completion_validation.scope: Local replay of the exact terminal postconditions over complete immutable native artifacts. The original Actions run remains failed. No timing is rerun or discarded, and no complete.json is added to the original artifacts.

policy: All predeclared observations and all data relocations are retained. Layout movement is not itself a timing verdict. No outlier removal; 2000 deterministic resamples of 32 balanced cycles. Simulated instruction counts are not native cycles.
